_comment: Temporary CMP/Wasm parity-gate exceptions, read by scripts/design-artifacts/rc-compare-gate.mjs
in compose-ai-tools and wired through the rc-cmp-wasm-allowlist input in .github/workflows/
design-artifacts.yml. Every entry needs id, reason and a non-expired YYYY-MM-DD expires date;
an expired entry fails the read, so the gate goes red rather than quietly widening.
Written against the four failures named by run #60 (2026-08-09), which is the first run that
exercised the lane. They are two distinct causes, not four, and neither is a mystery: both are
gaps the player already documents. See the reasons below.

entries.reason: CMP player has no LAYOUT_STATE (opcode 217): 'Unsupported operation at byte 349, opcode=217'. Listed as `217|LAYOUT_STATE|6|unsupported` in rc-operations.manifest, so this is a known unimplemented tier-6 operation rather than a defect in this catalog. Clears when the operation lands in the CMP player.
Light variant of the same LAYOUT_STATE (opcode 217) gap as AlarmPanel_Dark — identical failure at the same byte offset.

App-mode picture-entity references the camera frame by URL, so the document carries a BitmapData with encoding=1. The CMP player declines it by design: 'BitmapData[26]: encoding 1 requires an image host' (RcComposeSupport.kt). CI has no image host and no egress to Home Assistant, so there is nothing to fetch even if one were supplied. Clears when the wasm render harness supplies a stub image host, which lets the document draw everything except the unreachable frame — the same thing the JS and embedded lanes already do with these bytes.
Light variant of the same encoding=1 image-host gap as PictureEntity_AppMode_Dark.
